business_summary: J Frontier Co.,Ltd. engages in the healthcare sales, medical care sales, and healthcare marketing businesses in Japan. It operates SOKUYAKU, one-stop service platform that provides online medical consultations, medication guidance, prescription drug delivery, and digital transformation support for medical institutions. The company also sells health, beauty, education, healing, medicine, and healthcare products, as well as health food through mail order; and provides product sales promotion support services. In addition, it offers internet advertising for healthcare-related companies. J Frontier Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Shibuya, Japan.
